Name: Warp Anywhere
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[color=#e06666][size=5][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]
[size=4]Welcome to Warp Anywhere!
This mod lets you create warp points anywhere you like and warp back to them anytime.
Want to warp directly to your farmhouse bed?
That’s exactly what this mod is for.
You can set as many warp points as you like for town, shops, caves, or your favorite secret spots.
Don’t worry about travel time. Spend more time doing what you actually want to do.
You can sort your warp points into categories with names you choose.
Warp names and category names can be changed anytime, and multilingual copy and paste is supported.[/size]
[heading]
[color=#e06666][size=5]How to use[/size][/color][/heading]
[size=4]Press F9 to open the warp menu.
Press F10, or RB on a controller, to save your current location as a new warp point.
Select a saved warp point from the menu, then press Enter or A to warp there.
That’s it.
You’re ready to go anywhere![/size]
[heading]
[color=#e06666][size=5]Requirements[/size]
[/color][color=#e4e4e7][size=4]SMAPI is required.[/size][/color][/heading]
[size=4]Generic Mod Config Menu is not required, but highly recommended if you want to change key settings in-game.[/size]


[heading][color=#e06666][size=5]Installation[/size][/color][/heading]
[list=1]
[*][size=4]Install SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Download and unzip Warp Anywhere.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Place the Warp Anywhere [/size][size=4]folder into your Stardew Valley Mods [/size][size=4]folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Launch the game with SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Warp Anywhere
Manifest.Description: Warp anywhere from a single menu. Save your current spot, name it, sort warps into categories, and jump instantly. Full keyboard and controller support. SMAPI only. Includes a custom flower icon before warp names.
Manifest.Author: Yuzu17
